_notes: 1) Deut 32:64-65: The Breviary's verse numbers 32:64-65 correspond to Vulgate Deut 32:43 (Septuagint extended form, which has more lines than the MT/思高). 思高 Deut 32:43 text ('万国，你们应向他的百姓祝贺！因为上主必为自己的仆人报血仇，向仇敌报复，圣洁自己的土地和百姓。') is used as the basis, with the text split across two breviary sub-verses. 2) Exod 15:1: Latin 'Cantémus' (let us sing, cohortative) but 思高 renders as '我要歌颂' (I will sing). The 思高 text is followed verbatim per the rules. 3) Exod 15:3-4: Vulgate verse numbering does not align exactly with 思高; the content of Vulgate 15:3 ('Iste Deus meus') corresponds to latter part of 思高 v.2, and Vulgate 15:4 starts with 'Dóminus quasi vir pugnátor' (= 思高 v.3 'name 雅威'). The 思高 wording is used throughout. 4) Hosea 6: The Breviary labels vv.3a/3b/3c as '6:3' (three separate breviary lines), while 思高 has this content in vv.2-3. The 思高 text is split accordingly. 5) 'Canticum Oseæ' — rendered as 欧瑟亚的圣歌 (Canticle of Hosea).
